stories.title: Crisis en Ceuta y actualidad política, en directo | El Gobierno acusa de “irresponsable” al PP por sus críticas al traslado de migrantes

en.title: Crisis in Ceuta and political news, live | Government accuses PP of "irresponsible" criticism over migrant transfer
en.summary: Spain's government and opposition PP party clashed over the transfer of migrants from Ceuta's beaches to port facilities with over 1,700 capacity, with the government calling the opposition's criticism irresponsible while security forces managed the operation.

stories.title: El presidente del Puerto de Ceuta denuncia que «se ha enterado por la televisión» del traslado a los inmigrantes

en.title: President of Ceuta Port denounces that he "found out on television" about migrant transfer
en.summary: The Ceuta Port Authority president stated he received no prior official notification about the migrant relocation operation and learned about it through television broadcasts.

stories.title: Josep Martínez y Roberto entran en la lista de España, a la que regresan Huijsen y Fermín

en.title: Josep Martínez and Roberto enter Spain's squad, with Huijsen and Fermín returning
en.summary: Spain's national team announced its squad after winning the World Cup, adding Inter Milan goalkeeper Josep Martínez and Espanyol forward Roberto Fernández while welcoming back defender Huijsen despite losing Marcos Llorente and Borja Iglesias.

stories.title: Las autoridades mexicanas detienen a El Trompas, el presunto asesino de la estudiante española Claudia Tacoronte

en.title: Mexican authorities arrest El Trompas, alleged killer of Spanish student Claudia Tacoronte
en.summary: Mexican authorities arrested the suspect in the death of Spanish student Claudia Tacoronte, which officials characterized as a robbery-related altercation rather than a sexual assault.

stories.title: De la Fuente recupera a Huijsen y Fermín para estrenar la segunda estrella de España

en.title: De la Fuente recovers Huijsen and Fermín to debut Spain's second star
en.summary: Spain's coach calls up Josep Martínez and Roberto Fernández for the first time ahead of four Nations League matches against England, Croatia, and Czech Republic.

stories.title: Luis de la Fuente recluta a Josep Martínez, Huijsen, Fermín y Roberto Fernández en el regreso de la selección campeona del mundo

en.title: Luis de la Fuente recruits Josep Martínez, Huijsen, Fermín and Roberto Fernández in the return of the world champion selection
en.summary: Spain's coach names new players alongside mostly the same squad that won the World Cup in New York on July 19, with the Nations League opener against England on the 26th.

stories.title: Tensión y caos en el traslado de los migrantes de la playa Benítez al puerto de Ceuta

en.title: Tension and chaos in the transfer of migrants from Benítez beach to the port of Ceuta
en.summary: The first camp in the port area is full with hundreds of migrants, while many others still wait along the seafront promenade.

stories.title: Detienen al presunto responsable del asesinato de la española Claudia Tacoronte en México

en.title: Arrest of suspected perpetrator of murder of Spanish woman Claudia Tacoronte in Mexico
en.summary: Police arrested a man suspected of killing Spanish student Claudia Tacoronte in Mexico less than a week after the incident, with the case resolved unusually quickly compared to other femicides in the country.

stories.title: Avalancha inicial y momentos de tensión en el traslado de migrantes al campamento del puerto de Ceuta

en.title: Initial rush and tense moments in migrant transfer to Ceuta port camp
en.summary: A migrant transfer operation began before 7:00 AM at Ceuta beaches, with tensions arising as large numbers of people moved toward a new port camp facility.

stories.title: Tenso traslado de los migrantes al campamento del puerto de Ceuta

en.title: Tense migrant transfer to Ceuta port camp
en.summary: Civil Guard began a migrant transfer operation at 6:30 AM, requiring police reinforcement to manage a crowd that began running toward the destination.

stories.title: Detenido 'El Trompas', el sospechoso del asesinato de la española Claudia Tacoronte en México

en.title: El Trompas arrested as suspect in murder of Spanish woman Claudia Tacoronte in Mexico
en.summary: Authorities arrested a suspect in connection with the death of Claudia Tacoronte, a Spanish woman killed with a blade weapon on September 12 in Cuautla, Mexico.

stories.title: Detenido ‘El Trompas’, presunto asesino de la estudiante española Claudia Tacoronte en México

en.title: 'El Trompas' arrested, suspected killer of Spanish student Claudia Tacoronte in Mexico
en.summary: Mexican authorities captured Francisco Javier N in Cuautla, accused of killing 21-year-old exchange student Claudia Tacoronte last weekend. The suspect had shaved his head and changed his clothing.

stories.title: El Ibex duda con la cuádruple hora bruja

en.title: Ibex hesitates with quadruple witching hour
en.summary: The Ibex index showed caution on the final trading day of the week marked by futures expiration, as oil price declines offset gains from Japanese interest rate increases.

stories.title: Los investigadores logran vulnerar OpenAI utilizando modelos de Anthropic

en.title: Researchers breach OpenAI using Anthropic models
en.summary: A security company successfully hacked an AI laboratory by exploiting tools developed by a competing firm.

stories.title: Una anticapitalista busca el poder en Berlín

en.title: Anti-capitalist seeks power in Berlin
en.summary: Elif Eralp could potentially become the first mayor of Turkish origin in Germany's capital city.

stories.title: Tensión en el traslado de los inmigrantes al Puerto de Ceuta

en.title: Tension in migrant transfer to Ceuta Port
en.summary: Civil Guard and police coordinated a transfer operation of migrants from Ceuta beach settlements, managing a crowd that began running during the early morning operation.

stories.title: Los peligros de los auriculares en la oficina

en.title: The dangers of headphones in the office
en.summary: Listening to music while working can convey various counterproductive messages to colleagues and supervisors.
